ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; surface is approximately 95% low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to the distal lobe terminals.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous, uniform low-intensity region across the proximal and central areas; distinct high-contrast white contiguous blobs are localized at the left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an approximate 50-degree pixel angle; the deep vertex is partially occluded by high-intensity water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire continuous linear boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks ranges from 5 to 15 pixels relative to the mean edge vector; serrations are sharply defined against the sea-surface background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curve fitting along the sweep from the central notch to the lateral tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal terminal of the right lobe and smaller clusters on the left distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent physical protrusion and pigmentation anomaly on both lobe tips caused by dense barnacle clusters, notably altering the right tip's geometric silhouette.
